claims: Rows and contributions retain source event order/context.
Reverse then rotate maps each accepted raw scanline into the recorded position.
Budget exit is reached support-group count, before support pruning; it is not output truncation.

limitationsReviewed: Positions are scanline-support envelopes; no complete physical-support mask.
Whole-PNG placement membership is descriptive, including original quiet padding.
Known examples and controls are diagnostic, not held-out accuracy evidence.
Profile-local group IDs are not physical identities across calls.
Max1/max2/max255 alter observed acquisition/aggregation; no truncation assumption.
No threshold, filter, alternate digit search, majority or expected-truth correction selected.
publicationCaveats: The frozen shorthand scanline-support envelope is not a guaranteed enclosing envelope of all historical support. ODReader replaces the nearer quadrilateral side; an interior incoming scanline can replace a previous edge. Use collector representative quadrilateral or support-derived geometry, and retain individual contribution positions.
The three raw control spotchecks do not establish all semantic histories or a safe recognition policy; the photographed and same-payload cases have a separate reviewer.
scope: All derived provenance, counts, public records and comparison references checked; semantic raw histories spotchecked for only three fast distinct-payload control profiles. Other semantic case findings are reviewed separately.
